name: aromir_clean_wsl_benzene
purpose: TASKS 269 criterion 1 (18 Nov 2026): aromir installed from GitHub main 6047467 into a fresh venv (~/aromir_clean_269, Python 3.12.14, the README's two pip commands; freeze in aromir_clean_install_2026-11-18/wsl_pip_freeze.txt) runs `aromir spectrum` end to end on benzene with the bundled v1.4 release networks. The same run is benzene's aromir side for criterion 2. Benzene is the smallest molecule aromir admits (water is refused: no aromatic ring), so it is its own smoke. 4 threads, capped by probes/wsl_capped.sh beside the live search v14_stage1.
